findings.finding: Founder and board member Markus Törmänen converted 567,000 unlisted A shares into tradable B shares on 2026-10-08, two business days before the 30-day MAR closed period began. He sold 55,000 B shares at SEK 15.10 in July. The closed period ends when this report is published, so a sale of up to about 567,000 shares (roughly six to nine sessions of recent volume) becomes legally possible inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: July 2026: his 55,000-share sale on 2026-07-03 coincided with the defence-contract release that day, so no clean read. The B share has fallen 24.6% from the 2026-10-02 high of SEK 22.80 to SEK 17.20 with no company release since 2026-09-17; the cause of that drawdown is not established, so it is worth 0 on its own.

A | SE0016798532 | 567 000 (translation: 'exchange increase' of 567,000 Series B shares and 'exchange decrease' of 567,000 Series A shares, i.e. an A-to-B conversion)
findings.why_not_priced: It is public, but only in FI's Swedish-language insider register under the opaque label 'Utbyte'. No press release, no Redeye note and no Swedish press item mentions it. If it were priced as a supply event you would expect a discount opening up into the end of the closed period. The 25% fall since 2 October fits that, but it also fits the post-bring-up momentum unwinding, so most of this may already be in the price. That is why the size is small. The link from conversion to sale is my inference: a conversion also gives up votes, which leaves liquidity or a pledge as the likely reasons, but neither is stated.
findings.independence: Only the July sale in the same register (55,000 B at SEK 15.104 on 2026-07-03) points the same way: same source, so it is not independent. none.

findings.finding: The balance sheet removes the financing tail from this print. Cash was SEK 144,598K on 30 June with no interest-bearing debt, against a burn of about SEK 14m a quarter (Q2 operating cash flow before working capital -9,310K, capitalised development -4,491K). Q3 should close near SEK 130m, with no rights-issue risk attached to the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The two previous capital raises were announced with or just after reports (the 2025-09-01 directed issue; the 2026-05-12 directed issue plus rights issue, four days after the Q1 report, -9.7% that day). That pattern is why removing it matters, but the Q2 report already showed the cash.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the cash figure has been public since 12 August. It is filed because it removes the dilution tail that hit after the Q1 report, which makes a negative financing surprise unlikely. It is sized at 0 because the market has already been told the number.
